criteria.description: The layout mounts AssistantChat instead of AssistantSidebar and main content has no assistant-driven margin-right.
Assistant UI state exposes panelOpen, activeSessionId, hasUnread, and lastDismissedAt, with old open/collapsed localStorage migrated.
The closed assistant affordance is a fixed bottom-right bubble that toggles the overlay panel and shows unread/connection badge state.
The open assistant panel is a fixed overlay with header, session tabs, transcript, and composer, while preserving existing AssistantTurn and AssistantPlanApproval behavior.
New assistant status/result events received while the panel is closed set hasUnread, and opening the panel clears hasUnread.
